message:
fish: Improve custom CTRL-T command execution (#4909)

The custom CTRL-T command is now executed by the script in the current
shell session, instead of being called by fzf through a subshell. This
ensures that the value of $dir can't be altered by user initialization
scripts, and is also a little faster.

Fix #4498
